pass_summary: GG-specific Mental health evidence is thin and easy to over-claim: most of the well-known 'probiotic psychobiology' literature under the rhamnosus name (JB-1, HN001, CNCM I-3690) is a different strain and is excluded here. What remains for GG itself: a human cognition benefit confined to older adults with pre-existing cognitive impairment, and consistent but small (2-study) anxiolytic evidence in stressed rodents. Depression, general stress/cortisol, sleep, and autism-associated symptoms turned up no gradeable GG-specific human evidence in this pass.

claims.population_detail: adults 52-75 with baseline objective cognitive impairment
claims.effect_size: greater improvement in NIH Toolbox Total Cognition Score vs placebo, in the cognitively-impaired subgroup only
claims.tier_rationale: Sanborn et al. 2020 double-blind RCT, n=200 community-dwelling adults 52-75, 3 months. The benefit was confined to participants with objective baseline cognitive impairment; no effect emerged in cognitively intact participants. Scoped per tier rule 5 to the subgroup where the effect actually holds. Single unreplicated RCT, no SR, caps at B.
claims.notes: A separately published human trial testing cognition and stress markers in young men used strain JB-1, not GG, and is excluded here - see gaps.

claims.effect_size: reduced anxiety-like behavior on open-field testing in both studies (Neufeld 2019 P=0.01; Faucher 2022 P<0.03, active LGG arm only)
claims.tier_rationale: Juvale & Arulsamy 2025 SYRCLE-assessed SR of animal rhamnosus-anxiety studies separates results by strain; 2 of its 15 studies used GG specifically (Neufeld et al. 2019, maternal-separation rats; Faucher et al. 2022, C57BL/6 mice), both anxiolytic on open-field testing. The review's own comparison notes JB-1 (a different rhamnosus strain, not this roster entity) was the most consistent performer across the wider literature (7/8 studies) - GG's own evidence is smaller, though consistent within it. Faucher 2022 also tested heat-inactivated LGG, which did not replicate the effect; this entity is the live preparation, so that arm is noted but not built as a separate row. Tier is P by definition for animal rows; n_studies and consistency carry the strength signal.

gaps: mh-depression: no gradeable single-strain GG human trial found - the one positive BDI result used a GG+Bifidobacterium lactis combination product, not decomposable to GG alone per tier rule 2, and a registered pilot (NCT05564767) has no posted results yet. mh-stress-cortisol: the well-known positive academic-stress trial uses strain CNCM I-3690, not GG - excluded per the taxonomy trap noted in triage. mh-autism-symptoms: a pilot RCT of LGG in ADHD (not autism) turned up but ADHD has no matching outcome id and the pilot was not assessed in depth this pass - worth a closer look in a future pass, potentially as a proposed_impacts candidate.
